children: fell 0.065% premarket after the Chrysler parent said it is recalling 201,976 Jeeps in the United States. A software error may stop the tire pressure system spotting low pressure, or lighting the warning lamp. NHTSA disclosed the recall Wednesday.

The fault raises crash risk, and the vehicles don't comply with federal tire pressure monitoring standards. Nine model lines are affected. Wagoneer and Grand Wagoneer, both in standard and L versions. Grand Cherokee, plus the L and 4XE variants. Cherokee. The Grand Wagoneer L PHEV.

title: Stellantis Pulls Back 201,976 Jeeps on a Software Fault
